tooltips.savings_rate: (income - spending) / income, per month plus 3-mo rolling average. good ≥20%, warning 10-20%, bad <10%. Transfers excluded.
tooltips.net_cash_flow: Monthly income - spending, with a 3-mo rolling average. Negative months highlighted. Transfers excluded.
tooltips.fixed_vs_variable: Share of spending in fixed vs variable categories. warning if fixed share of income >50%, bad if >65%. Override per category.
tooltips.essential_discretionary: Spending split against a 50/30/20 benchmark (needs/wants/savings). Override essentiality per category.
tooltips.recurring: Debits grouped by normalized merchant with 3+ occurrences, consistent cadence and amount within +-10% of median.
tooltips.runway: current balance / avg monthly spending (last 3 months, transfers excluded). good ≥6, warning 3-6, bad <3 months.
tooltips.category_share: Percent share per category for the period plus month-over-month movers.
tooltips.top_merchants: Top 10 merchants by total spend and by transaction count.
tooltips.budget: actual vs budget per category with projected month-end spend. warning at 80% of budget, bad when over.
tooltips.safe_to_spend: (expected monthly income - committed fixed - spent so far this month) / days left in the month.
tooltips.spend_day: Average spend per day-of-month. 'Days until money runs out' = balance / avg daily spend over last 30 days.
tooltips.weekday_weekend: Average daily spend weekdays vs weekends and their ratio.
tooltips.payment_mode: Share of spending by mode (UPI/Card/ATM-Cash/NEFT-IMPS/Cheque/Other). Cash withdrawal share >15% flagged as untracked.
tooltips.small_tx_leakage: Total and count of debits below the threshold (default ₹200) as a share of total spending.
tooltips.income_stability: Coefficient of variation of monthly income (needs 3+ months). good <0.15, warning 0.15-0.35, bad >0.35.
tooltips.debt_to_income: total monthly EMI / monthly income. good <30%, warning 30-40%, bad >40%.
tooltips.emergency_fund: liquid balance / average monthly essential spending, in months. good ≥6, warning 3-6, bad <3.
tooltips.fees_interest: Sum of bank charges, late fees, card interest and GST detected by keywords.
